SELECT s.id AS session_id, s.session_no AS session_no, s.tenant_code AS tenant_code, s.channel_id AS channel_id, s.customer_id AS customer_id, s.status AS status, s.agent_id AS agent_id, s.intent AS intent, s.emotion AS emotion, s.source AS source, s.start_time AS start_time, s.end_time AS end_time, c.name AS customer_name, c.level AS customer_level, lm.content AS last_content, lm.sender_type AS last_sender_type, lm.send_time AS last_time, COALESCE(mc.msg_count, 0) AS msg_count FROM session s LEFT JOIN customer c ON c.id = s.customer_id AND c.tenant_code = s.tenant_code AND c.is_deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT m.content, m.sender_type, m.send_time FROM session_message m WHERE m.tenant_code = s.tenant_code AND m.session_id = s.id AND m.is_deleted = FALSE ORDER BY m.send_time DESC, m.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) lm ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT COUNT(1) AS msg_count FROM session_message m2 WHERE m2.tenant_code = s.tenant_code AND m2.session_id = s.id AND m2.is_deleted = FALSE ) mc ON TRUE WHERE s.tenant_code = #{tenantCode} AND s.is_deleted = FALSE
AND s.agent_id = #{agentId} AND s.status = 3
AND s.agent_id IS NULL AND s.status IN (1, 2)
AND ( s.session_no ILIKE '%' || #{keyword}::text || '%' OR c.name ILIKE '%' || #{keyword}::text || '%' )
ORDER BY COALESCE(lm.send_time, s.start_time) DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, tenant_code, session_no, channel_id, customer_id, status, skill_group_id, agent_id, intent, emotion, source, start_time, end_time, csat_score, last_msg_seq, create_time, update_time, creator, editor, is_deleted FROM session WHERE tenant_code = #{tenantCode} AND channel_id = #{channelId} AND customer_id = #{customerId} AND status IN (1, 2, 3) AND is_deleted = FALSE ORDER BY start_time DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE session SET agent_id = #{agentId}, status = 3, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{sessionId} AND tenant_code = #{tenantCode} AND agent_id IS NULL AND status IN (1, 2) AND is_deleted = FALSE
mapper.select: UPDATE session SET last_msg_seq = last_msg_seq + 1, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tenant_code = #{tenantCode} AND id = #{sessionId} AND is_deleted = FALSE RETURNING last_msg_seq

SELECT id, tenant_code, session_no, channel_id, customer_id, status, skill_group_id, agent_id, intent, emotion, source, start_time, end_time, csat_score, last_msg_seq, create_time, update_time, creator, editor, is_deleted FROM session WHERE tenant_code = #{tenantCode} AND agent_id IS NULL AND status IN (1, 2) AND is_deleted = FALSE ORDER BY start_time LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT DISTINCT tenant_code FROM session WHERE agent_id IS NULL AND status IN (1, 2) AND is_deleted = FALSE
